headline: Argentina October Auto Sales Fall 12%, Marking Seventh Consecutive Drop
summary: Vehicle patent registrations in Argentina dropped 12% in October compared to the previous year, marking the seventh consecutive monthly decline in auto sales.
why: Auto sales act as a key indicator of consumer discretionary spending and domestic economic health during periods of tight financial conditions.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Falling sales registrations directly indicate a contraction in domestic automotive retail demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
